_note: Source of truth for the build cycle. Built from PLUGIN_REFERENCE_MATRIX.md (64 plugin rows; the matrix also lists naitv-mcp-core and three templates, which are excluded: core is naitv-mcp itself, and templates are replaced by scripts/scaffold_plugin.sh). Plus two repo plugins that predate the matrix (lazy-dev, loop-engineering-go). Order = build order. status: exists | planned | needs-spec | blocked. Only planned entries with a complete tools list are built. needs-spec entries get a spec first (see CYCLE_PROMPT.md step 2b). Do not invent tool names. l5 is the gated uplift result: pending | measured-helpful | measured-no-uplift | not-applicable.
